SELECT * FROM ( SELECT M.MESSAGE_ID, M.SENDER_NO, M.RECEIVER_NO, M.PRODUCT_ID, M.CONTENT, M.IS_READ, M.CREATED_AT, case when U.IS_DELETED = 1 then '탈퇴한 회원' else U.NICKNAME end as OPPONENT_NICKNAME, P.TITLE AS PRODUCT_TITLE, P.STATUS AS PRODUCT_STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY M.PRODUCT_ID, M.SENDER_NO ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM MESSAGES M JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_NO = M.SENDER_NO JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = M.PRODUCT_ID WHERE M.RECEIVER_NO = #{myNo} AND M.RECEIVER_DELETED =0
) WHERE RN =1 ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT M.MESSAGE_ID, M.SENDER_NO, M.RECEIVER_NO, M.PRODUCT_ID, M.CONTENT, M.IS_READ, M.CREATED_AT, case when U.IS_DELETED = 1 then '탈퇴한 회원' else U.NICKNAME end as OPPONENT_NICKNAME, P.TITLE AS PRODUCT_TITLE, P.STATUS AS PRODUCT_STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY M.PRODUCT_ID, M.RECEIVER_NO ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM MESSAGES M JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_NO = M.RECEIVER_NO JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = M.PRODUCT_ID WHERE M.SENDER_NO = #{myNo} AND M.SENDER_DELETED = 0 ) WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT M.MESSAGE_ID, M.SENDER_NO, M.RECEIVER_NO, M.PRODUCT_ID, M.CONTENT, M.IS_READ, M.CREATED_AT, case when U.IS_DELETED = 1 then '탈퇴한 회원' else U.NICKNAME end as OPPONENT_NICKNAME FROM MESSAGES M JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_NO = #{opponentNo} WHERE M.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND((M.SENDER_NO = #{myNo} AND M.RECEIVER_NO = #{opponentNo}) OR (M.SENDER_NO = #{opponentNo} AND M.RECEIVER_NO = #{myNo})) AND((M.SENDER_NO = #{myNo} AND M.SENDER_DELETED = 0) OR (M.RECEIVER_NO = #{myNo} AND M.RECEIVER_DELETED = 0)) ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT
select count(*) from MESSAGES where RECEIVER_NO = #{userNo} and IS_READ = 0
